Scope and content:  The original finding aid described this photograph as:
Original Caption: An aerial view reveals the the Outer Banks Scenic Byway's Bodie Island Light Station from the east. The lighthouse stands stoic with its horizontal black-and-white striped "daymark," with the white Keepers Quarters and Oil House barely visible to the left. The Atlantic Ocean's waves create a horizontal fringe of froth in the distance.
Location: Cape Hatteras National Seashore, North Carolina (35.194° N 75.732° W)
